NSR_call_to_hijrah_category = {
	NSR_hijrah_rif = {
		allowed = { original_tag = NSR }
		icon = generic_political_rally
		cost = 50
		days_remove = 60
		days_re_enable = 120
		fixed_random_seed = no
		visible = { has_country_flag = NSR_p_call_to_hijrah }
		available = { custom_trigger_tooltip = {
			tooltip = NSR_tr_NSR_p_call_to_hijrah
			has_country_flag = NSR_p_call_to_hijrah
		} }
		complete_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_hijrah_wave
			hidden_effect = { NSR_hijrah_campaign_start = yes }
			custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_angers_rif
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = SPR }
				SPR = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = NSR_hijrah_rif } }
			}
		}
		remove_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_muhajirun_p3
			hidden_effect = {
				add_to_variable = { NSR_muhajirun = 3 }
				NSR_clamp_turmoil = yes
			}
			hidden_effect = { NSR_hijrah_campaign_end = yes }
		}
		ai_will_do = { factor = 2 }
	}

	NSR_hijrah_maghreb = {
		allowed = { original_tag = NSR }
		icon = generic_political_rally
		cost = 50
		days_remove = 60
		days_re_enable = 120
		fixed_random_seed = no
		visible = { has_country_flag = NSR_p_call_to_hijrah }
		available = { custom_trigger_tooltip = {
			tooltip = NSR_tr_NSR_p_call_to_hijrah
			has_country_flag = NSR_p_call_to_hijrah
		} }
		complete_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_hijrah_wave
			hidden_effect = { NSR_hijrah_campaign_start = yes }
			custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_angers_maghreb
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = FRA }
				FRA = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = NSR_hijrah_maghreb } }
			}
		}
		remove_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_muhajirun_p4
			hidden_effect = {
				add_to_variable = { NSR_muhajirun = 4 }
				NSR_clamp_turmoil = yes
			}
			hidden_effect = { NSR_hijrah_campaign_end = yes }
		}
		ai_will_do = { factor = 2 }
	}

	NSR_welcome_the_muhajirun = {
		allowed = { original_tag = NSR }
		icon = generic_welfare
		days_re_enable = 30
		available = { custom_trigger_tooltip = {
			tooltip = NSR_tr_muhajirun_3
			check_variable = { NSR_muhajirun > 2 }
		} }
		custom_cost_trigger = {
			check_variable = { NSR_muhajirun > 2 }
		}
		custom_cost_text = NSR_cost_muhajirun_3
		complete_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_muhajirun_m3
			hidden_effect = {
				add_to_variable = { NSR_muhajirun = -3 }
				NSR_clamp_turmoil = yes
			}
			add_manpower = 3000
			custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_lowest_hold
			hidden_effect = { NSR_hold_to_lowest_state = yes }
		}
		ai_will_do = { factor = 3 }
	}
